decisive_items: Malignant squamous cells contained eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli; mitotic figures were present
Classic-appearing hyperkeratotic lesion with many pseudohorn cysts
Proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells originated from one lateral end, pushing down into the dermis and involving many hairs
response.rationale: R2 is the champion because it has more comprehensive support spans that cover various aspects of the diagnosis, including histopathological features and neoplastic cell characteristics. C1 is the runner-up because it is a more specific subtype of R2, but it lacks the breadth of support spans found in R2.
